name: Disable Windows Defender AV Security Monitoring
description: Detects attackers attempting to disable Windows Defender using Powershell
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Minimal, for some older versions of dev tools, such as pycharm, developers were known to sometimes disable Windows Defender to improve performance, but this generally is not considered a good security practice.
query: (((process.executable:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe)) OR (process.pe.original_file_name:(PowerShell.EXE OR pwsh.dll))) AND (process.command_line:(*\-DisableBehaviorMonitoring\ $true* OR *\-DisableRuntimeMonitoring\ $true*))) OR ((process.executable:*\\sc.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:sc.exe) AND ((process.command_line:*stop* AND process.command_line:*WinDefend*) OR (process.command_line:*delete* AND process.command_line:*WinDefend*) OR (process.command_line:*config* AND process.command_line:*WinDefend* AND process.command_line:*start\=disabled*)))
